title: free-disk-space deployment diagram
description: free-disk-space runs on the user's own Mac, nowhere else: as a command in a terminal, and, once installed, as a launchd login item that runs the same binary in the background. It talks to no server; everything it reaches is on the same machine. The binary comes from the zazzle Homebrew formula in the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z, the zazzle release tarball or a local cargo build; it is started directly or as `zazzle free-disk-space ...`.

nodes.name: The user's Mac
nodes.description: macOS with an APFS data volume; the binary also builds and partly runs on Linux, where compression, cloning, Finder and launchd steps are unavailable.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: A person running free-disk-space commands and reading their reports.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: A coding agent running the same commands in the developer's session, as agents/skills/free-disk-space/SKILL.md tells it.

nodes.name: free-disk-space command
nodes.description: One run of a subcommand: scan, status, list, compress, dedupe, clean, or daemon install, uninstall or status. Runs as the invoking user and exits. Started directly, or through the zazzle invoker (macos/c/zazzle/), which replaces itself with this binary from its own directory and passes the arguments on.

nodes.name: launchd (user gui domain)
nodes.description: macOS's service manager: loads ~/Library/LaunchAgents/local.free-disk-space.plist, starts the daemon at load and at every login, and restarts it if it exits.

nodes.name: free-disk-space daemon run
nodes.description: The same binary as a background process at nice 10 with low-priority I/O; checks free space every cadence of awake time and runs clean --apply below the threshold; writes ~/Library/Logs/free-disk-space.log.
nodes.condition: After daemon install, until daemon uninstall

nodes.name: Scan state file
nodes.description: SQLite, embedded in the binary, in a file at $FDS_STATE or ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/scan.sqlite3.

nodes.name: Clean progress file
nodes.description: Plain text at ~/.local/state/free-disk-space/clean-progress.txt: one line per step an interrupted clean --apply finished, so the next applying run skips them; removed after a complete run, ignored once older than 12 hours.

nodes.name: macOS and developer tools
nodes.description: Programs run as child processes with time limits: ditto, xattr, lsof, ps, pgrep, git, osascript (Finder and Docker Desktop), brew and docker; the ones found on PATH are used only if installed.

nodes.name: Docker Desktop
nodes.description: Pruned, its containers stopped and asked to quit, through its CLI and osascript.
nodes.condition: The docker target is chosen and Docker Desktop is already running

artifacts.name: free-disk-space
artifacts.description: The one binary: cargo build --release -p free-disk-space, or the universal (arm64 and x86_64) build in zazzle-macos-universal.tar.gz from a release, which the zazzle Homebrew formula installs with the toolbox's other binaries.

artifacts.name: local.free-disk-space.plist
artifacts.description: Written by daemon install into ~/Library/LaunchAgents with the binary's absolute path and the daemon's settings; removed by daemon uninstall.
